name: Future Avoid
author: Joakim Hentula
description: A reflex game: steer your dot around the screen and dodge the incoming triangles to keep your score going up.

descriptions.en: A reflex game: steer your dot around the screen and dodge the incoming triangles to keep your score going up.
descriptions.it: Un gioco di riflessi: muovi il tuo punto sullo schermo e schiva i triangoli in arrivo per far salire il punteggio.
